outcome: Prevalence of diabetes in pregnant women
Admission to special care nursery/neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Pregnant women who attended an Australian tertiary hospital between 2011 and 2017.
finding: The incidence of diabetes in pregnancy increased from 2011 to 2017, but it did not affect the relative risk of adverse birth outcomes after adjusting for confounding factors.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was measured as an outcome
